subject: Pricing conversation: hosted API pilot + commit tiers (Stratus AI)
messages:
From: Alice Chen <alice@stratus.ai>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Hosted API pilot + commit tiers - quick ask

Hi Logan,

Thanks for the demo yesterday — the team was impressed with Redwood's latency and the batching suggestions. We're planning a 6-month pilot that could scale to ~4B tokens/month if the initial tests go well. Before we lock dates, procurement asked for preliminary pricing: our preferred path is usage-based with a 6-month commit at a blended per-token rate tied to volume breakpoints.

High level ask:
- Pilot commit: 6 months, expected ramp to 4B tokens/month by month 3
- Target blended discount: ~30% off list per-token rate (we currently model this as $0.0009/token after discount)
- SLA/throughput requirements: 95th pctile latency < 120ms for 8k context models

Can you confirm whether a custom rate band/exception is needed or if we can fit this into existing tiered commits? If an exception is required, procurement asked for an internal approval note they can reference.

Attached is a short usage forecast and an initial term sheet (pdf) — happy to hop on a quick call.

Cheers,
Alice
Alice Chen
Head of ML Platforms, Stratus AI
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Alice Chen <alice@stratus.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Feb 2027 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Hosted API pilot + commit tiers - quick ask

Hi Alice — great to hear.

We can support the pilot and the SLA targets; based on the forecast the economics look promising but this volume puts you above our standard hosted tier breakpoints. I'll scope an internal exception request for a custom blended band.

Next steps from my side:
- Share the term sheet + forecast with revenue ops and finance for an exception review (attached).
- Propose a two-step approval: up to 25% discount can be approved at Sales Manager level; anything >25% to 40% requires Revenue Ops + Finance signoff and an Exec sign-off for >35%.
- Offer a technical canary: start with 1B tokens in month 1 with automated monitoring and an opt-out if latency targets aren't met.

I'll loop in Marissa and Karthik internally — expect an internal note from me within the hour.

Best,
Logan Wright
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Attachments: Stratus_Term_Sheet_v2.pdf, Stratus_usage_forecast.xlsx
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Feb 2027 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: INTERNAL: Stratus AI - request for custom hosted rate band (DEAL-2027-0472)

Team — quick summary and ask (internal):

Deal summary:
- Account: Stratus AI (prospect)
- Pilot: 6 months, ramp to ~4B tokens/month by month 3 per their forecast
- Product: Hosted API (text generation, 8k context model family)
- Requested commercial: blended per-token target ~$0.0009 (roughly 30% off list) with a 6-month commit

Why exception is needed:
- Volume exceeds our published hosted tiers where standard breakpoints cap at 2B tokens/month for the current ratecard.
- To avoid losing the deal we should offer a custom band with staged pricing tied to actual ramp.

Recommended ask to approve:
- Commercial ask: authorize up to a 30% blended discount for the initial 6-month pilot, with a performance/latency SLA and a usage fence (minimum 1B in month 1 or pilot converts to pay-as-you-go).
- Contractual guardrails: monthly reconciliation, overage at list rates, and automatic downtier if average latency >150ms for two consecutive weeks.

Numbers (very rough):
- Expected billed tokens over 6 months (forecast): 12B
- Revenue at list: $0.000012/token? (Note: replace with correct list) — see attached calc in spreadsheet
- Estimated gross margin impact: needs finance input (cc Sean)

Specific approvals requested:
1) Revenue Ops/Finance: confirm margin and approve up to 30% blended exception (Sean)
2) Legal: confirm SLA/termination language (Neha)
3) Marissa: sales leadership approval to offer the pilot structure

Attachments: Stratus_Term_Sheet_v2.pdf, Stratus_usage_forecast.xlsx

Can you weigh in by EOD so I can give procurement a timeline?

Thanks,
Logan
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Feb 2027 14:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: INTERNAL: Stratus AI - request for custom hosted rate band (DEAL-2027-0472)

Logan — thanks for the summary and the attachments. A few quick points: 

1) We should avoid a single-blended discount without staged breakpoints. Suggest tiered breakpoints with an initial promotional discount (month 1-2) of 25% and a ramp-up to 30% if they hit the 3B+ threshold by month 3. That reduces risk and aligns incentives.
2) We need a firm usage floor to protect unit economics — I agree with the 1B minimum in month 1, otherwise revert to list.
3) Finance calculus: Sean, can you run a margin delta on the attached forecast and confirm breakeven threshold (I suspect it's closer to 22-28% depending on model selection & quantization).

If Finance is comfortable, I can sign off on up to 28% as an initial offer and escalate beyond that to Marissa. For anything >33% we should require VP approval.

Karthik
Director, Revenue Operations
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Feb 2027 09:18:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: INTERNAL: Stratus AI - request for custom hosted rate band (DEAL-2027-0472)

Folks — reviewed the forecast and ran a sensitivity with our cost-per-token model (assumes standard hosted runtime, no extra private infra). Key takeaways: 

- If they hit 4B/mo steady state, we can support up to ~30% discount and retain acceptable contribution margin, assuming they run on the recommended quantized variant.
- If usage stays below 2B/month the margin impact is material. Hence the 1B floor and staged breakpoints are necessary.
- Approvals: I can approve up to 28% from Finance. Anything above 28% requires VP Sales concurrence and a formal exception memo (include ARR projection and churn risk analysis).

Procurement asks (from the buyer): SOC2 certificate, data handling note, and a DocuSign-ready term sheet. Legal/Compliance to confirm.

Sean
Head of Finance Operations

>

Date: Fri, 12 Feb 2027 15:03:00 -08:00
Subject: FINAL REQUEST: Exec approver for >28% exception (Stratus AI, DEAL-2027-0472)

Marissa — quick ask for final approval path. Finance (Sean) can clear up to 28%. Karthik supports a staged approach and is OK to sign off up to 28% as well. Stratus is pushing for a 30% blended band out of procurement.

Request: can you approve (or escalate to VP sales) a final exception to allow a 30% blended discount for the 6-month pilot, conditional on:
- 1B minimum in month 1 (or pilot converts to pay-as-you-go)
- Tiered breakpoints: Month1-2 = 25%, Month3+ = 30% if ramp achieved
- Monthly reconciliation and overage at published list rates
- SLA: automatic downtier if 95th pctile latency >150ms for two consecutive weeks

If you approve, I'll:
- Send a DocuSign term (link above) with the staged bands
- Share SOC2 and the short data handling note with Stratus
- Lock the 30% band for the 6-month pilot only (renewals revert to standard ratecard unless renegotiated)

DocuSign draft: https://docusign.com/Envelope/ABC-9876
